<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#063336" flood-opacity=".12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F9FAFA"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="20" y="20" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">9:41</text>
    <line x1="322" y1="18" x2="322" y2="12" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="327" y1="18" x2="327" y2="10" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="332" y1="18" x2="332" y2="8" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="346" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="343" y1="18" x2="349" y2="18" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="359" y="8" width="20" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="361" y="10" width="14" height="7" rx="1" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <line x1="380" y1="12" x2="380" y2="15" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="62" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="27,61 20,67 27,73" fill="none" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="2.2"/>
    <line x1="21" y1="67" x2="38" y2="67" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="2.2"/>
    <text x="55" y="64" font-family="Poppins" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#0A2533">Order status</text>
    <circle cx="353" cy="63" r="16" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
    <rect x="347" y="57" width="12" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <polygon points="350,68 348,72 353,69" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <circle cx="356" cy="58" r="2.5" fill="#EC2A38"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Order details background -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="120" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">ORDER ID</text>
    <text x="20" y="143" font-family="Poppins" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#121212">#3339</text>
    <text x="270" y="120" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">PLACED ON</text>
    <text x="270" y="143" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#333333">Jun 18, 2024</text>

    <g filter="url(#shadow)">
      <rect x="20" y="163" width="350" height="116" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    </g>
    <circle cx="56" cy="204" r="24" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
    <text x="56" y="211" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="17" font-weight="600" fill="#4B9460">CK</text>
    <text x="92" y="199" font-family="Poppins" font-size="17" font-weight="600" fill="#121212">Chinese Kitchen</text>
    <text x="92" y="221" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Homestyle Chinese meals</text>
    <rect x="276" y="188" width="72" height="25" rx="12" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
    <text x="312" y="205" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#267347">Preparing</text>
    <line x1="44" y1="246" x2="346" y2="246" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="44" y="265" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Arrives today by 10:15 AM</text>
    <text x="346" y="265" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#121212">$28.50</text>

    <!-- Progress -->
    <line x1="49" y1="326" x2="341" y2="326" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="4"/>
    <line x1="49" y1="326" x2="195" y2="326" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="4"/>
    <circle cx="49" cy="326" r="9" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <polyline points="44,326 48,330 55,322" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="326" r="9" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <polyline points="190,326 194,330 201,322" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="341" cy="326" r="9" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C7C7C7" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="49" y="351" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#333333">Confirmed</text>
    <text x="195" y="351" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#333333">Preparing</text>
    <text x="341" y="351" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#999999">On the way</text>

    <text x="20" y="393" font-family="Poppins" font-size="17" font-weight="600" fill="#121212">Your order</text>
    <text x="370" y="393" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">Need help?</text>

    <g filter="url(#shadow)">
      <rect x="20" y="411" width="350" height="146" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    </g>
    <rect x="36" y="428" width="62" height="54" rx="8" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
    <circle cx="82" cy="439" r="7" fill="#FBBD00"/>
    <polygon points="47,475 64,450 74,461 84,451 96,475" fill="#5DB075"/>
    <text x="116" y="441" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#121212">Kung Pao Chicken</text>
    <text x="116" y="461" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">1 × $14.00</text>
    <text x="346" y="452" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">$14.00</text>
    <line x1="36" y1="494" x2="354" y2="494" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="36" y="520" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#333333">Vegetable Fried Rice</text>
    <text x="36" y="540" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">1 × $10.50</text>
    <text x="346" y="530" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">$10.50</text>

    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="584" width="350" height="60" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E6EBF2"/>
      <circle cx="48" cy="614" r="15" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
      <line x1="48" y1="606" x2="48" y2="622" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="40" y1="614" x2="56" y2="614" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="76" y="610" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#333333">Delivery instructions</text>
      <text x="76" y="629" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Leave at the front door</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="770" width="390" height="74" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="770" x2="390" y2="770" stroke="#E6EBF2"/>
    <polygon points="38,797 48,789 58,797 58,809 51,809 51,801 45,801 45,809 38,809" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="48" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Home</text>
    <circle cx="126" cy="797" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="133" y1="804" x2="140" y2="811" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="126" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Explore</text>
    <rect x="181" y="786" width="28" height="25" rx="13" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
    <polyline points="188,795 188,804 202,804 202,795" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="792" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="195" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">Orders</text>
    <circle cx="274" cy="795" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <polyline points="267,806 274,811 281,806" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="274" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Community</text>
    <circle cx="344" cy="793" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="344" cy="806" rx="11" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="344" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Profile</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Dimming layer -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#0A2533" opacity=".48"/>

  <!-- Cancellation dialog -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="20" y="258" width="350" height="318" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="303" r="30" fill="#FFF3F3"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="303" r="16" fill="none" stroke="#EC2A38" stroke-width="2.4"/>
    <line x1="188" y1="296" x2="202" y2="310" stroke="#EC2A38" stroke-width="2.4"/>
    <line x1="202" y1="296" x2="188" y2="310" stroke="#EC2A38" stroke-width="2.4"/>
    <text x="195" y="367" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#121212">Cancel this order?</text>
    <text x="195" y="397" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Are you sure you want to cancel</text>
    <text x="195" y="418" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">your order from Chinese Kitchen?</text>

    <rect x="44" y="445" width="302" height="44" rx="10" fill="#FFF3F3" stroke="#F64A4A" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="472" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#CC0000">Cancellation may not be refundable</text>

    <g>
      <rect x="44" y="510" width="144" height="44" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="116" y="538" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">Keep order</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="202" y="510" width="144" height="44" rx="10" fill="#5DB329"/>
      <text x="274" y="538" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Cancel order</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
